**Segmentation:** Split the ray into segments based on the intersection intervals with the primitives.
**Emission Accumulation:** For each segment $k$ within a primitive $i$, compute the accumulated emission.
**Compositing:** Composite the accumulated emissions from all segments along the ray to produce the final pixel color.
